notes.title: 🛠️ Megabattle Demo – Smarter Battles & UI Upgrades (v1.0.4)
notes.content:
[h2]🛠️ Megabattle Demo – Smarter Battles & UI Upgrades (v1.0.4)[/h2][p]Hey pilots![/p][p]We’ve just deployed [b]version 1.0.4[/b] of the [i]Megabattle[/i] demo, and it’s packed with quality-of-life improvements, visual polish, and a smarter battle experience. While this isn’t a full content update, it brings crucial refinements that make fights feel more responsive, strategic, and satisfying.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🧠 Smarter Combat[/h3][p]Introducing the [b]Damage Predictor[/b]:
You can now preview how your attack will affect the enemy’s [b]armor[/b], [b]integrity[/b], and special traits like [b]plated[/b] and [b]spiked[/b] — even during enemy turns.
This makes planning your moves much more transparent and strategic.[/p][p]We also added a [b]radar effect[/b] that shows when your parts are being targeted — giving you more clarity on incoming threats.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]👁️ Visual Feedback & UI Polish[/h3][list][*][p][b]Turn display[/b] is now centered and more prominent (“Your Turn” / “Enemy Turn”).[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy hands now retain played cards with a transparent effect — you can track what’s been used.[/p][/*][*][p]Cards now have [b]hover effects[/b] in rewards and battles that feel more responsive.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]workshop panel[/b] now only shows [b]unequipped parts[/b], making management easier.[/p][/*][*][p]Stats like [b]PWR[/b], [b]DEF[/b], and status effects now use icons (ongoing update).[/p][/*][*][p]Battle tooltips have been reworked to avoid visual clutter and now scale with text.[/p][/*][*][p]ESC now opens [b]settings[/b] in battle (soon across all menus).[/p][/*][*][p]Deck and discard [b]buttons + tooltips[/b] are now functional during and after battles.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧪 System Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Power-up cards now require a [b]confirmation click[/b] after placing them in the center.[/p][/*][*][p]Robots start with a [b]weak torso[/b], but can equip a standard one with a modifier — a meaningful early-game decision.[/p][/*][*][p]Better [b]hover zones[/b] for cards in the hand (you don’t have to go all the way up to un-hover).[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]tutorial triggers[/b] to help first-time players.[/p][/*][*][p]And yes, the card and part [b]emoji cleanup[/b] is in progress![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🐞 Bug Fixes & Tweaks[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed map nodes spawning too close together.[/p][/*][*][p]Recharge cards now work correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed area-of-effect prediction bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected lingering buffs like [b]Ionic Overflow[/b] lasting between battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Acidic Conduit now correctly triggers synergy effects with cards like [b]Sulfuric Veins[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The integrity bar has been stabilized to stop it from shifting unexpectedly.[/p][/*][*][p]Two cards that weren’t displaying blocked parts in gray now work properly.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]💬 Why this update matters[/h3][p]Version 1.0.4 brings [i]Megabattle[/i] a big step closer to the feel we’re aiming for: smart, tactical, and visually clear combat where decisions matter. We're listening closely to your feedback and making steady progress toward launch.[/p][p]Coming next:[/p][list][*][p]Deeper deckbuilding tools[/p][/*][*][p]More visual effects for hits and abilities[/p][/*][*][p]Continued balancing and clarity improvements[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]👉 [b]Play the updated demo now[/b]:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1602030/MegaBattle/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]👉 [b]Join our Discord and help shape the game[/b]:
[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/PZMjvf9Y"]https://discord.gg/PZMjvf9Y[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for your ongoing support — and stay tuned for more robotic mayhem!
Let’s keep improving this card battler together. ⚡🤖[/p][p]— Team Mad Cat Corp[/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Megabattle Demo – Gameplay & Balance Update (v1.0.3)
notes.content:
[p][/p][h1]🛠️ Megabattle Demo – Gameplay & Balance Update (v1.0.3)[/h1][p]Hey pilots![/p][p]We’ve just launched a new update for the [b]Megabattle demo[/b] focused on making the game [b]more intuitive, fair, and satisfying to play[/b]. This isn't a full overhaul — but it's one of our most important steps so far in terms of [b]refining the player experience[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🎮 What’s new in v1.0.3?[/h2][h3]✅ [b]Improved Gameplay Flow[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The [b]UI during battles has been refined[/b], making it easier to select cards, assign parts, and understand available actions.[/p][/*][*][p]The flow of turns feels more intuitive and responsive — no more clunky decision-making![/p][/*][/list][h3]⚖️ [b]Balance Pass[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Several [b]balance tweaks[/b] were applied to enemy stats, damage, and rewards to smooth out the difficulty curve.[/p][/*][*][p]We've addressed a major issue where players could exploit the game by [b]focusing on a single weak enemy part[/b] to break the combat system. That’s no longer viable — strategy now matters more than ever.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🐞 [b]Bug Fixes & Text Corrections[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Minor bugs and inconsistencies have been ironed out[/p][/*][*][p]Several [b]text and localization fixes[/b] throughout the game[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]💬 Why this update matters[/h2][p]This version of the demo marks a big improvement in how Megabattle [i]feels[/i]. It’s faster, clearer, and more balanced — and it gets us closer to the level of polish we’re aiming for.[/p][p]We’re now shifting our focus to:[/p][list][*][p]Adding [b]better audiovisual feedback[/b] in battles[/p][/*][*][p]Making the combat feel more “punchy” and dynamic[/p][/*][*][p]Continuing to refine game balance and pacing based on your feedback[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]👉 [b]Play the updated demo now[/b]:
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1602030/MegaBattle/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]👉 [b]Join our Discord and help shape the game[/b]:
[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/PZMjvf9Y"]https://discord.gg/PZMjvf9Y[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for being part of this journey — and keep the feedback coming!
Let’s make this the best robot battler it can be. ⚡🤖[/p][p]— Team Mad Cat Corp[/p]

notes.title: New demo 🔥🔥
notes.content:
Attention, gamers and thrill-seekers! We are happy to unveil the highly anticipated free demo of MegaBattle, our action-packed roguelike! 


🚀 What is MegaBattle? 🌍

MegaBattle is a roguelike card game that combines strategic deckbuilding elements with the thrill of epic robot battles. Build a custom deck and embark on a procedurally generated journey, facing increasingly challenging trials.

🌟 Key Features of the Demo 🎯

- Engage in epic battles against other bots using your robot parts and battle deck 
- Unleash your strategy skills discovering cards of attack and defense (more cards are coming!)
- Upgrade your bot mix and matching different bots classes (2 classes available for the demo)
- Gain rewards and upgrade your battle deck

🎮 Who are we? 🦾

MadCat is an indie studio from Brazil and MegaBattle is our first game. This is our second demo release and after several months of development we make a lot of changes and progression. We hope you enjoy and we value your feeback, 


🔥 Join the MegaBattle Community! 🌐

We value your feedback and want to hear about your adventures in the MegaBattle demo. Please join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/GT3nUpMJ

Thanks for you support and we hope you enjoy playing MegaBattle.

- Megabattle team
